name: tightness review of the working tree

acceptance: scores every component file 1-5 for tightness and lists the lines to cut
lint results are quoted from lint.json, not re-counted
the repo under review is unchanged

expect: lint.json and conformance.json exist; lint.json is `pmos lint --json` on the tree under review and conformance.json is `pmos eval --framework tightness --json`

report.md has a Verdict section answering "Is every component tight: does every line tell the agent what to do or why, with nothing a capable reader would skip?" with a 1-5 score and a one-line reason for each of: budgets, structure, filler, cite-don't-copy

report.md has a table with one row per component file in lint.json (file, kind, words/budget from lint.json, a 1-5 tightness score) and, for every file scored under 5, the exact lines to cut or merge, each with path:line
every lint error and warning in lint.json appears in the report with its file, copied, not re-judged
no listed cut drops an instruction a step, principle check or conformance case depends on; where a cut changes meaning the report says so
report.md has Quick wins and What's already good sections
git status of the repo under review is the same before and after (verify-clean passed); nothing outside outputs/<id>/ was written
the result has status done, no actions, and a summary under 80 words with the scores
